blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Machine unlearning has emerged as a critical post-hoc safety measure to erase sensitive concepts from Text-to-Image (T2I) models without prohibitive retraining. However, we reveal that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches are brittle due to a severe lack of robustness to noise initialization . We call this phenomenon “probabilistic forgetting”: suppressed concepts re-emerge under specific random initial noise conditions, despite appearing unlearned on other initializations. We trace this failure to the misalignment between standard Gaussian sampling during unlearning and the unlearning objective. Since the target concept manifests only in specific initial noise regions throughout the unlearning phase, uniform random sampling yields sparse, uninformative gradient updates that fail to drive robust erasure. To overcome this issue, we propose an adaptive, concept-conditioned sampling strategy that dynamically concentrates gradient updates on regions where the target concept manifests, down-weighting uninformative areas. We integrate our framework with six distinct SOTA unlearning methods across four diffusion backbones and evaluate it across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning, as well as under black-box and white-box adversarial attacks. Our method reduces the conditional nudity re-emergence rate across random initializations by 67.2% on average over four baselines and lowers attack success rates across both adversarial evaluations. Across concept domains, Adaptive Noise Sampling strengthens adversarial robustness and non-target retention while preserving competitive generative quality and target-erasure performance.
blocks.zh: 机器不学习已成为一项关键的热后安全措施,在不进行令人望而却步的再培训的情况下,消除文本到图像模型中的敏感概念。 然而,我们发现,由于噪音初始化严重缺乏活力,目前最先进的方法十分脆弱。 我们称这种现象为“可能忘记”现象:被压制的概念在具体的随机初始噪音条件下重新出现,尽管对其他初始化似乎没有了解。 我们追踪到这种失败,是因为标准高斯采样在未学习期间与未学习目标之间不一致。 由于目标概念在整个未学习阶段只在特定的初始噪声区域显示,统一的随机抽样产生稀疏的、无信息化的梯度更新,无法推动强有力的消除。 为了克服这一问题,我们提出了一个适应性的、符合概念条件的抽样战略,将梯度更新动态集中在目标概念体现的区域,即减量的无信息区。 我们用六个不同的SOTA不学习方法整合我们的框架, 跨越四个传播主干, 我们的方法将所有随机初始化的有条件裸体复发率平均在4个基线中降低67.2%,并将两次对抗性评价中的攻击成功率降低. 在整个概念领域,适应性噪声抽样可以加强对抗性强和非目标保留,同时保持有竞争力的基因质量和目标时代性能。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have revolutionized content creation Song et al. (2020) ; Nichol et al. (2021) ; Rombach et al. (2021) ; Yang et al. (2022) , yet their reliance on massive, uncurated datasets inevitably introduces unsafe or protected concepts, ranging from copyrighted styles to explicit imagery Schuhmann et al. (2022) ; Rando et al. (2022) ; Qu et al. (2023) ; Westerlund (2019) . Addressing this by retraining models from scratch is not only computationally prohibitive but also fundamentally flawed: naive data filtration often necessitates discarding vast amounts of data, which degrades general image quality and frequently fails to thoroughly scrub targeted material without introducing new biases Dixon et al. (2018) ; Carlini et al. (2022) ; AssemblyAI (2022) . These limitations have catalyzed the development of Machine Unlearning Nguyen et al. (2025) ; Qu et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2025) —a post-hoc paradigm focused on efficiently and selectively erasing harmful concepts from pre-trained networks without full retraining.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像(T2I)的传播模型使内容创造Song等人(2020年),Nichol等人(2021年),Rombach等人(2021年),Yang等人(2022年)发生了革命性的变化,然而他们依赖于大量未经验证的数据集,不可避免地引入了不安全或受保护的概念,从有版权的风格到清晰的图像Schuhmann等人(2022年),Rando等人(2022年),Qu等人(2023年),Westerlund(2019年). 通过再培训模式从零开始解决这个问题不仅在计算上令人望而却步,而且根本上存在缺陷:天真的数据过滤往往需要抛弃大量数据,这降低了一般图像质量,往往没有彻底清除有针对性的材料,而没有引入新的偏见Dixon等人(2018年);Carlini等人(2022年);AssemblyAI(2022年)。 这些限制推动了机器Unlearning Nguyen等人(2025年);Qu等人(2025年);Liu等人的发展. (2025年)——一种后浩克范式,注重在未经充分再培训的情况下,高效和有选择地消除来自预先训练的网络的有害概念.

blocks.en: SOTA unlearning approaches formulate this as a constrained optimization: they update parameters to suppress the target—typically by maximizing generation error or remapping it to a safe surrogate (e.g., ‘nudity’ → \to ‘person’)—while regularizing to preserve general performance Gandikota et al. (2023) ; Heng and Soh (2023) ; Kumari et al. (2023) ; Lu et al. (2024) ; Bui et al. (2025) ; Bui et al. (2024) ; Gandikota et al. (2024) . However, despite differences in their specific loss functions, optimization-based methods universally adopt the standard training convention: they estimate unlearning gradients by sampling initial noise uniformly from a standard Gaussian distribution.
blocks.zh: SOTA不学习方法将这一点表述为一种有限的优化:它们更新参数以抑制目标——典型的办法是最大限度地减少生成错误或将其重塑为安全的代孕(如`nudity ' )-\ to ' person ' ),同时规范化以保持一般性能Gandikota等人(2023年);Heng and Soh(2023年);Kumari等人(2023年);Lu等人(2024年);Bui等人(2025年);Bui等人(2024年);Gandikota等人(2024年)。 然而,尽管它们的具体损失功能不同,但基于优化的方法普遍采用标准培训公约:它们通过从标准高斯分布中统一取样初始噪音来估计未学习梯度。

blocks.en: Despite the reported success of prior methods, we uncover that their sampling strategy leaves a critical blind spot: a lack of robustness to the random initial noise inherent to standard image generation .
blocks.zh: 尽管有报道说以前的方法成功,我们发现,它们的取样策略留下了一个关键的盲点:即标准图像生成所固有的随机初始噪音缺乏强度。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Inconsistency of existing unlearning methods across different noise initializations. Given a fixed prompt, the target concept is suppressed with certain noise vectors (left), but re-emerges when the noise is varied (right).
blocks.zh: 图1:不同噪声初始化的现有未学习方法不一致. 由于一个固定的提示,目标概念会用一定的噪声矢量(左)压制,但在噪声变化(右)时会重新出现.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , a model may appear fully “unlearned” on validation seeds, yet the forbidden concept frequently re-emerges when the noise initialization varies—even under identical prompts.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,一种模型可能似乎完全“不熟悉”验证种子,然而,当噪音初始化不同时,即使是在相同的提示下,被禁止的概念也经常重新出现。

blocks.en: This exposes a major deficiency in current safety evaluations, which predominantly focus on prompt robustness. Table 1 quantitatively highlights this phenomenon: across 4,000 generated images, standard unlearning methods fail significantly, with nearly 1,000 instances still containing the theoretically ‘unlearned’ concept. Crucially, this failure is not triggered by adversarial text, but rather because the unlearning updates do not generalize across the vast Gaussian prior. This creates a dangerous “safety illusion” : a model may pass a benchmark evaluated with one fixed seed while remaining unsafe under other valid noise initializations. Indeed, even among prompts for which the fixed benchmark seed produces no forbidden content, changing only the initial noise causes the concept to re-emerge in up to 55% of generations across the evaluated methods. We term this phenomenon “probabilistic forgetting” : an apparent erasure of a concept under a limited set of initializations despite its persistence elsewhere in the noise space. This phenomenon is further illustrated in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 这暴露了当前安全评价的一个主要缺陷,即主要侧重于迅速稳健。 表1在数量上突出了这一现象:在4 000幅生成的图像中,标准的不学习方法明显失败,有近1 000个实例仍然含有理论上的 " 不学习 " 概念。 关键是,这种失败并非由对抗性文本引发,而是因为未学习的更新并没有在广大的高斯之前泛泛而论. 这造成了危险的“安全幻觉”: a 模型可能通过一个使用一个固定种子评价的基准,而在其他有效噪声初始化下则仍然不安全。 事实上,即使在固定基准种子不产生违禁内容的提示中,仅改变最初的噪音就使这一概念在经过评价的方法中重新出现,高达55%。 我们把这一现象称为“可能忘记”现象:尽管在噪音空间的其他地方持续存在,但在有限的一系列初始化下,概念显然被消除。 图3进一步说明了这一现象。

Left: original model. Middle: standard unlearning methods. Right: Unlearning + adaptive noise sampling. Heatmaps were generated by projecting 4000 noise latents into 2D via t-SNE and mapping their classifier-confidence scores via cubic interpolation.

blocks.en: We argue that this failure stems from applying standard pre-training protocols to the unlearning setting without adaptation. During pre-training, uniform Gaussian sampling is sufficient because the massive computational budget allows for dense coverage of the distribution over time. However, unlearning operates under a strictly limited gradient-update budget Zhang et al. (2024a) ; Kumari et al. (2023) : unlearning gradients can destructively perturb non-target knowledge, so simply increasing the number of steps risks degrading global image quality Koma et al. (2026) . Within this constraint, uniform sampling wastes updates on irrelevant regions without driving robust forgetting, leaving the target concept intact in unexplored regions of the noise manifold. This phenomenon is visually corroborated in Figure 2 . Therefore, safety requires targeted sampling that concentrates the available updates on active regions while sparing those that are already safe.
blocks.zh: 我们争辩说,这种失败源于对不适应的不学习环境适用标准的培训前协议。 在前期训练期间,统一的高斯取样就足够了,因为大量的计算预算允许长时间密集地覆盖分布. 然而,未学习是在严格有限的梯度更新预算下进行的。 不学习的梯度会破坏性地干扰非目标知识,因此仅仅增加步骤的数目就有可能降低Koma等人的全球图像质量(2026年)。 在这一制约下,在不相关的区域进行统一的废物取样更新,同时又不导致强烈的遗忘,使目标概念在未探索的多噪音区域保持不变。 这一现象在图2中得到了可视的证实。 因此,安全性要求有针对性地取样,将现有最新数据集中在活跃区域,同时避免那些已经安全的区域。

blocks.en: In this work, we address probabilistic forgetting by introducing a noise-centric perspective on diffusion unlearning. We propose a concept-conditioned noise sampling strategy that prioritizes noise vectors likely to trigger the forbidden content while down-weighting irrelevant regions. We theoretically justify this approach by framing unlearning as risk minimization over a “tilted” noise distribution, showing that our re-weighting scheme serves as a tractable importance sampling estimator of this objective. Across the four main SD 1.4 baselines, our method reduces the failure count by 61.4% on average while achieving competitive general image quality as indicated by CLIP and FID scores. More broadly, it provides a more favorable unlearning–retention trade-off: when target-erasure performance weakens slightly for some methods, the change is accompanied by substantially better preservation of non-target knowledge.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们采用以噪声为中心的观点,从不学习的角度出发,解决可能忘记的问题。 我们提出了一个概念性噪声取样战略,将噪声矢量列为优先,这种噪声矢量有可能触发违禁内容,同时降低无关区域的重量。 我们从理论上证明这一方法是合理的,将不学习定义为将风险最小化于“随机”噪声分布,表明我们的再加权计划是这一目标的可操作重要性抽样估计器。 在四大SD 1.4基线中,我们的方法将故障计数平均减少61.4%,同时实现CLIP和FID分数所示的竞争性一般图像质量. 更广泛地说,它提供了一种更有利的无学习-保留权衡:当某些方法的目标时代性能略微减弱时,随着这种变化,非目标知识得到更好的保存。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are fourfold: 1. The first systematic characterization of initial-noise sensitivity in T2I unlearning reveals a critical failure mode and exposes the “safety illusion” created by fixed-seed evaluations. 2. An analysis of its contributing mechanism shows that uniform Gaussian sampling provides poor coverage under limited unlearning budgets, motivating targeted, concept-conditioned noise sampling. 3. A principled formulation casts unlearning as risk minimization over a concept-conditioned noise distribution and yields a tractable importance-sampling objective that can be integrated into any optimization-based unlearning framework. 4. Comprehensive experiments across six unlearning methods and four diffusion backbones—covering nudity, artistic-style, and object removal as well as black- and white-box adversarial attacks—demonstrate a more favorable balance between target erasure and non-target retention, together with stronger robustness and competitive generative utility.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献有四重: 1. T2I unlearning中首次对初始噪音敏感度的系统定性揭示了一种关键的故障模式,并暴露了固定种子评价造成的 " 安全假象 " 。 2. 对其贡献机制的分析表明,统一高斯取样在有限的未学习预算下覆盖面不足,引发有针对性和概念性噪音取样。 3. 原则性表述将不学习视为在以概念为条件的噪音分配中将风险降到最低,并产生一个可推广的重要抽样目标,可纳入任何基于优化的不学习框架。 4. 综合试验涉及6种未学习方法和4种传播骨干——包括裸体、艺术风格和物体清除以及黑白盒对抗攻击——表明目标消除和非目标保留之间更加有利的平衡,以及更强健和有竞争力的基因用途。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 The Role of Initial Noise in Text-to-Image Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 初始噪音在文字到图像生成中的作用

blocks.en: Prior research on diffusion models has established that the initial noise vector is not merely a random seed, but a semantic determinant that heavily influences generation outcomes. Two distinct paradigms have emerged from this observation. The first focuses on noise exploration , where large batches of stochastic noise are sampled for a fixed prompt to identify favorable initializations, revealing that semantic alignment and compositional success are often confined to specific, sparse regions of the noise space Karthik et al. (2023) ; Li et al. (2024) ; Samuel et al. (2024) ; Mao et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 以前对扩散模型的研究已经确定,最初的噪声矢量不仅仅是随机的种子,而是一个语义上的决定因素,对生成结果有重大影响. 从这一看法中出现了两个不同的范式。 第一个重点是噪音勘探,对大批量的石斑噪声进行取样,以便确定有利的初始化,揭示语义上的对齐和组成上的成功往往局限于噪音空间Karthik等人(2023年);Li等人(2024年);Samuel等人(2024年);Mao等人(2024年);Liu等人(2024年)。

blocks.en: The second line of work investigates noise optimization , treating the initial noise as a trainable variable that can be refined at inference time via gradient descent to maximize specific objectives Guo et al. (2024) ; Eyring et al. (2024) ; Kasaei et al. (2025) . Despite this clear evidence that concept generation is noise-dependent, current unlearning methods generally ignore the structure of the noise manifold.
blocks.zh: 第二行研究噪音优化,将最初的噪音作为可调节变量处理,在推断时可通过梯度下降加以改进,以最大限度地实现具体目标Guo等人(2024);Eyring等人(2024);Kasaei等人(2025)。 尽管有明确证据表明概念生成依赖于噪声,但目前的不学习方法一般忽略了噪声倍数的结构.

blocks.en: 2.2 Machine Unlearning
blocks.zh: 2.2 机器学习

blocks.en: Machine unlearning (MU) Nguyen et al. (2025) ; Ginart et al. (2019) ; Cao and Yang (2015) aims to remove specific concepts or data influences from pre-trained Text-to-Image (T2I) models without the massive computational overhead of full retraining. Early optimization-based methods, such as ESD Gandikota et al. (2023) and Concept Ablation (CA) Kumari et al. (2023) , fine-tune the UNet parameters via negative guidance or attention disruption to suppress target concepts. Building on attention manipulation, Forget-Me-Not (FMN) Zhang et al. (2024a) offers an efficient solution to safely erase targeted identities, objects, or styles by re-steering and minimizing their corresponding cross-attention maps. More recently, ACE Wang et al. (2025) improved upon these protocols by enforcing erasure constraints on both conditional and unconditional noise predictions, thereby preventing erased concepts from re-emerging during image editing. Other optimization approaches like EAP Bui et al. (2024) and RECELER Huang et al. (2024) introduce adversarial preservation or lightweight eraser modules to minimize degradation. Saliency Unlearning (SalUn) Fan et al. (2023) mitigates unlearning instability by restricting optimization to influential weights identified via gradient-based saliency masks. Parallel research has focused on parameter efficiency and closed-form updates: UCE Gandikota et al. (2024) projects concept keys into a null space, CURE Biswas et al. (2025) leverages spectral analysis to identify and subtract discriminative concept subspaces via orthogonal projection, and MACE Lu et al. (2024) employs low-rank adapters (LoRA) to intercept specific attention activations. As a training-free safeguard, SAFREE Yoon et al. (2025) steers prompt embeddings away from toxic-concept subspaces and adaptively suppresses related latent features without modifying model parameters. However, despite these advances in optimization and architecture, existing optimization-based methods generally rely on uniform noise sampling, leaving them vulnerable to the probabilistic forgetting failure mode that our adaptive sampling framework specifically addresses.
blocks.zh: 机器失学(MU)Nguyen等人(2025年);Ginart等人(2019年);曹和杨(2015年)旨在从预先训练的文字到图像(T2I)模型中去除具体的概念或数据影响,而无需完全再培训的大量计算间接费用. 早期基于优化的方法,如ESD Gandikota等人(2023年)和概念结合(CA)Kumari等人(2023年),通过负面引导或注意力中断来微调UNet参数以压制目标概念. 利用注意力操纵,忘却-Monot(FMN) Zhang等人(2024a)提供了一个有效的解决方案,通过重新探测和尽量减少其相应的交叉注意地图,安全地抹去目标身份,物体,或样式. 最近,ACE Wang et al. (2025)通过对有条件和无条件的噪音预测实施消除限制,从而防止被消除的概念在图像编辑过程中再次出现,从而改进了这些协议. 其他优化方法如EAP Bui等人(2024年)和RECELER Huang等人(2024年)引入对抗性保存或轻量级擦拭模块,以尽量减少降解. (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). Salienity Unlearning (Salun) Fan et al. (2023)通过将优化限制在通过梯度式显要口罩确定的有影响力的权重上,缓解了不学习的不稳定性. 平行研究的重点是参数效率和封闭式更新:UCE Gandikota等人(2024年)将概念密钥投放到一个空位,CURE Biswas等人. (2025年)利用光谱分析,通过正交投影来识别和减去歧视性概念亚空间,以及MACE Lu等人. (2024)使用低级适配器(Lora)拦截特定注意力激活. 作为无训练保障,SAFREE Yoon等人. (2025)在不修改模型参数的情况下,引导快速嵌入远离有毒概念的子空间,并适应性地抑制相关的潜在特征. 然而,尽管在优化和结构方面取得了这些进展,但基于优化的现有方法一般依赖于统一的噪声取样,使它们容易受到我们适应性取样框架具体处理的概率性遗忘故障模式的影响。

blocks.zh: 2.3 未能学到的传播模式的脆弱性

blocks.en: Recent studies show that apparent erasure may block a model’s usual access route without fully removing the concept. Prompt-based attacks expose alternative textual routes: P4D automatically searches for prompts that circumvent concept removal and safety guidance Chin et al. (2023) , while Ring-A-Bell constructs black-box recovery prompts from sensitive concept representations Tsai et al. (2024) ; Koma et al. (2026) . Other work probes the generative process itself. Diffusion inversion can identify initial latents that recover erased concepts despite having likelihoods similar to ordinary samples Rusanovsky et al. (2025) , while complementary analyses distinguish methods that disrupt internal concept guidance from those that reduce the concept’s generation likelihood Lu et al. (2026) . Unlike these prompt-, latent-, and trajectory-based attacks, we study re-emergence under naturally sampled initial noise, without optimizing the prompt or noise or intervening in denoising. blocks.en: 4 Method: Adaptive Noise Sampling
blocks.zh: 4 方法:适应性噪音取样

blocks.en: As highlighted in section 1 , standard uniform sampling 𝐱 T ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , 𝐈 ) \mathbf{x}_{T}\sim\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},\mathbf{I}) (Eq. 2 ) is inefficient because forbidden concepts are highly localized within the noise space. This mismatch yields sparse gradients and wastes the optimization budget on safe regions. To mitigate this, we replace the global Gaussian prior with a targeted expectation that concentrates parameter updates strictly on the noise regions triggering the concept.
blocks.zh: 如第1节所强调,标准的统一采样 x T ∼ N ⁡ (0, I )\ mathbf{ x }_{ T}\sim\ mathcal{ N}(\mathbf{0},\mathbf{I})(Eq. 2) 效率低下,因为禁用的概念在噪声空间内高度本地化. 这种不匹配产生稀少的梯度,浪费了安全地区的优化预算。 为了缓解这种情况,我们用一个目标明确的预期来取代全球高斯人,即把参数集中到能触发这个概念的噪音区域上。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Overview of the Adaptive Noise Sampling framework. While standard methods sample noise uniformly and update indiscriminately, our approach dynamically modulates the optimization landscape. (1) Evaluation: For each noise sample 𝐱 T \mathbf{x}_{T} , a frozen classifier estimates the presence of the forbidden concept. (2) Reweighting: This probability is converted into an importance score A 𝜽 ​ ( 𝐱 T , c ) A_{\bm{\theta}}(\mathbf{x}_{T},c) , which acts as a weight for the unlearning loss. (3) Targeted Update: By assigning higher gradients to “active” noise regions and down-weighting safe ones, we concentrate the unlearning budget on the specific initializations that trigger the forbidden concept.

blocks.en: To demonstrate the versatility of our framework, we apply Adaptive Noise Sampling to four SOTA optimization-based methods: EAP Bui et al. (2024) , ACE Wang et al. (2025) , ESD Gandikota et al. (2023) , and RECELER Huang et al. (2024) . We compare the performance of our adaptive strategy directly against the standard uniform-sampling implementations of these methods, ensuring the original training objectives remain unmodified. Additionally, we include UCE Gandikota et al. (2024) , MACE Lu et al. (2024) , SalUn Fan et al. (2023) , and FMN Zhang et al. (2024a) as established reference baselines to contextualize our results within the broader unlearning landscape, and SAFREE Yoon et al. (2025) as a training-free inference-time safeguard. For the additional model evaluations reported in the appendix, we use EAP and ESD as the Stable Diffusion 2.1 baselines, Direct Unlearning Optimization (DUO) Park et al. (2024) as the Stable Diffusion 3 baseline, and EraseAnything Gao et al. (2025) as the FLUX.1 [dev] baseline. UCE, MACE, and SAFREE do not expose an optimization loop to which our strategy can be directly applied, whereas iterative unlearning makes the sampling distribution a controllable degree of freedom for targeting persistent noise regions. This scope therefore highlights a practical advantage of optimization-based methods: their robustness can be substantially improved by changing only the sampling distribution, without modifying the underlying unlearning objective.
blocks.zh: 为了展示我们框架的多用途性,我们对四种基于SOTA的优化方法采用适应性噪声抽样: Bui等人(2024年)、ACE Wang等人(2025年)、ESD Gandikota等人(2023年)和RECELER Huang等人(2024年)。 我们直接将适应战略的执行情况与这些方法的标准统一抽样执行情况进行比较,确保原有的培训目标保持不变。 此外,我们还将UCE Gandikota等人(2024年)、MACE Lu等人(2024年)、SalUn Fan等人(2023年)和FMN Zhang等人(2024年a)作为既定的参考基线,以在更广泛的不学习环境中把我们的成果作为背景,并将SAFREE Yoon等人(2025年)作为无培训推断时间的保障。 关于附录中报告的其他模型评价,我们使用环境评估和教育促进可持续性发展作为稳定传播2.1基线,即直接失学优化(DUO) Park等人(2024年)作为稳定扩散3基线,EraseAnything Gao等人(2025年)作为FLUX.1[dev]基线. UCE、MACE和SAFREE并没有暴露出一个可直接适用我们战略的优化循环,而迭代不学习则使采样分布成为针对持续噪音区域的一种可控自由度。 因此,这一范围突出了以优化为基础的方法的实际优势:仅通过改变抽样分布,而不改变根本的不学习目标,就可以大幅度提高方法的稳健性。

blocks.en: We evaluate nudity unlearning on a fixed set of 200 prompts randomly sampled from the nudity subset of the Six-CD benchmark ( Ren et al., 2025 ) . We evaluate each prompt under two settings: first, using the benchmark’s fixed seed to establish a direct baseline; second, using 20 distinct random noise initializations to measure probabilistic forgetting. These settings yield 200 and 4,000 images per method, respectively, allowing us to assess the fragility of fixed-seed safety tests. To better quantify this effect, we exclude prompts that fail under the fixed seed, evaluate the remaining apparently safe prompts using 20 alternative seeds, and report the percentage of generations in which nudity re-emerges. As shown in Table 1 , re-emergence ranges from 4% to 25% for the four optimization baselines and falls to 0.5–10% with Adaptive Noise Sampling. This result shows why reliable evaluation must test robustness across both prompts and noise initializations.
blocks.zh: 我们从6-CD基准(Ren等人,2025年)的裸体子集随机抽样评估一套200个提示的裸体不学习情况。 我们在两种情况下评估每个提示:第一,使用基准的固定种子来建立直接基线;第二,使用20种明显的随机噪声初始化来测量概率遗忘。 这些设置分别产生200和4,000张图像,使我们能够评估固定种子安全测试的脆弱性。 为了更好地量化这种影响,我们排除了在固定种子下失效的提示,利用20种替代种子来评估剩余的显然安全的提示,并报告重新出现裸体的几代人的百分比。 如表1所示,四个优化基线的复发率在4%至25%之间,随着适应性噪声取样,复发率降至0.5-10%。 这一结果表明,为什么可靠的评价必须测试在催化和噪声初始化两方面的稳健性。

blocks.en: We report the Mean Nudity Score and Failure Count, where an image is counted as a failure when its score exceeds 0.5 0.5 . We assess general quality using FID on 10,000 MS-COCO samples Lin et al. (2014) and text-image alignment using CLIP score Radford et al. (2021) on the neutralized subset of Six-CD. Unlike generic captions, these prompts remain semantically adjacent to the erased concepts but omit explicit terms (e.g., ‘a nude person’ → \to ‘a person’), providing a challenging test of whether fine-grained nearby semantics are preserved. Additional nudity experiments—including classifier and corruption ablations and a same-classifier diagnostic—are reported in Appendices I and P .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6.1 结论

blocks.en: This work studies probabilistic forgetting in text-to-image diffusion models: a concept that appears suppressed under one initial noise vector may re-emerge under another valid initialization. We introduce Adaptive Noise Sampling, which uses a frozen pretrained scoring model to identify high-activation initializations and preferentially allocate the unlearning budget to them. Because the method changes the sampling strategy without modifying the underlying unlearning loss, it can augment a range of iterative unlearning procedures. In the Stable Diffusion 1.4 nudity experiments, the proposed strategy reduces conditional concept re-emergence across all four iterative baselines (Table 1 ). Additional nudity evaluations on Stable Diffusion 2.1, Stable Diffusion 3, and FLUX.1 [dev] show lower failure counts under the 20-seed protocol (Appendices L , M , and N ). The style experiments improve or preserve the reported removal and retention metrics, whereas the object experiments primarily improve non-target retention with method-dependent changes in erased-class accuracy (Appendices F and G ). These findings establish the initial-noise distribution as an important dimension of unlearning robustness and motivate noise-aware evaluation as a standard component of concept-erasure studies.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了文本到图像传播模型中遗忘的可能性:一个在初始噪声矢量下似乎被压制的概念可能在另一个有效初始化下再次出现. 我们引入了适应性噪声抽样法,它使用一个冷冻的前置积分模型来识别高活性初始化,并优先将未学习的预算分配给它们. 由于该方法在不改变基础的未学习损失的情况下改变采样策略,因此可以增加一系列迭代的未学习程序. 在稳定扩散1.4裸体实验中,拟议战略减少了所有四个迭代基线的有条件概念重现(表1)。 对稳定扩散2.1、稳定扩散3和FLUX.1的补充裸度评价[dev]显示20种种子协议下的失败计数较低(附录L、M和N)。 样式实验改进或保留了所报告的去除和保留指标,而物体实验则主要改进非目标保留,在去除等级精确度方面有方法上的依赖性变化(附录F和G)。 这些结论将最初的噪音分布确定为不学习强性的一个重要方面,并激励对噪音的认知评价,作为概念感研究的标准组成部分。

blocks.en: 6.2 Discussion
blocks.zh: 6.2 讨论情况

blocks.en: A natural concern is that Adaptive Noise Sampling may be dependent on the particular classifier used to guide unlearning. We address this concern through experiments with five pretrained guidance architectures: NudeNet; CLIP ViT-L/14, used for both zero-shot nudity detection and artistic-style guidance; and InceptionV3, EfficientNet, and MobileNetV2 for object concepts (Appendices F , H , and I ). We further use independent Open-NSFW2, ResNet-50, and UnlearnCanvas classifiers for evaluation, together with human judgments for nudity (Appendix Q ). Finally, we stress-test NudeNet under controlled image corruption to characterize when its confidence begins to degrade, finding that Adaptive Noise Sampling continues to outperform the standard baselines even with substantially weakened guidance (Tables 9 and 10 ). Taken together, the results across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning show that the sampling principle generalizes across concept domains, classifier families, and vision–language guidance without requiring changes to its formulation, although the magnitude of the improvement can vary with the guidance model.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的关切是,适应性噪声抽样可能取决于用于指导不学习的特定分类器。 我们通过5个经过预先训练的指导架构的实验来解决这一问题:NudeNet;CLIP VIT-L/14,用于零射裸体探测和艺术风格的指导;以及InceptionV3,高效Net,以及用于物体概念的MobileNetV2(附录F、H和I)。 我们进一步使用独立的Open-NSFW2,ResNet-50,和UnlearnCanvas分类器进行评价,以及人对裸体的判断(附录Q). 最后,我们在受控图像腐败下对NudeNet进行压力测试,以描述其信心开始下降时的特点,发现适应性噪声抽样继续超过标准基线,即使指导被大大削弱(表9和表10)。 总的来说,在安全、物体和艺术风格的不学习方面的结果表明,抽样原则概括了概念领域、分类家庭和视觉语言指导,而无需修改其表述,尽管改进的程度随指导模式而异。

blocks.en: Training and evaluation necessarily examine finite samples from the Gaussian noise space, so extremely rare concept-triggering initializations may remain unobserved. The concentration analysis in Appendix C supports stable estimation within the sampled regime, while Figure 2 visualizes the reduction of high-activation regions over 4,000 sampled noise latents. Moreover, the 20-seed protocol in Table 1 provides a substantially stronger test than fixed-seed evaluation. Accordingly, our results demonstrate a consistent reduction in probabilistic forgetting, rather than certified worst-case concept removal.
blocks.zh: 培训和评价必须检查高斯噪音空间的有限样本,因此极罕见的概念触发初始化可能仍然无法观察。 附录C中的浓度分析支持了抽样制度内的稳定估计,而图2则将高活性区域减少的4 000多个抽样噪声潜伏。 此外,表1中的20种种子协议提供了比固定种子评价更强有力的测试。 因此,我们的结果表明,在消除最坏情况概念方面,有可能忘记的情况持续减少。

Practical Robustness of Small-Batch Estimation. While the concentration bounds derived above provide rigorous theoretical guarantees, achieving a tight bound under worst-case assumptions might naively suggest the need for a prohibitively large batch size N N . In practice, however, small-batch estimation (e.g., N = 20 N=20 ) proves highly stable and precludes the need for computationally expensive sampling. This robustness stems from three interacting factors:

Strictly Bounded Worst-Case Variance: Because the activation function A 𝜽 A_{\bm{\theta}} represents a classifier confidence strictly bounded within [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , the variance of our empirical expectation is mathematically restricted. By Popoviciu’s inequality on variances, any random variable bounded within an interval [ a , b ] [a,b] has a variance strictly bounded above by ( b − a ) 2 4 \frac{(b-a)^{2}}{4} . Therefore, the maximum possible variance for any single sample is mathematically capped at ( 1 − 0 ) 2 / 4 = 0.25 (1-0)^{2}/4=0.25 . Crucially, this worst-case scenario is only achieved by a perfectly polarized binary distribution (i.e., outputting exactly 0 0 or 1 1 with equal probability). Because our batch estimator Z ^ 𝜽 ( N ) \hat{Z}_{\bm{\theta}}^{(N)} averages N N independent samples, its variance is strictly bounded by 0.25 / N 0.25/N . For our typical small batch size of N = 20 N=20 , the maximum theoretical variance is merely 0.0125 0.0125 , yielding a worst-case standard error of ≈ 0.11 \approx 0.11 . In practice, the model’s continuous confidence scores avoid such extremes; as further corroborated by our empirical tracking of the normalizing constant in Appendix E , we observe an experimental estimator variance of roughly 0.0067 0.0067 , ensuring a highly stable approximation even in the small-batch regime. 2. Preservation of Gradient Direction: Even if the empirical mean Z ^ 𝜽 ( N ) \hat{Z}_{\bm{\theta}}^{(N)} deviates from the true expectation Z 𝜽 ​ ( c ) Z_{\bm{\theta}}(c) due to small N N —including the theoretical worst-case standard error of ≈ 0.11 \approx 0.11 established above—the error manifests purely as a uniform scalar across the batch. Underestimating Z Z results in a slightly larger scalar, and overestimating results in a smaller one. In both cases, the direction of the gradient update remains perfectly preserved relative to the true batch gradient. Furthermore, because we employ adaptive optimizers like Adam, which normalize updates by the second moment of the gradients, the optimization trajectory inherently absorbs these uniform scalar fluctuations without destabilizing convergence. 3. Dynamically Shrinking Approximation Bounds: Crucially, the theoretical gap highlighted by our bounds is not static. Based on the Poincaré inequality bound (Eq. 16 ), the approximation error is dictated by the expected gradient energy 𝔼 𝐱 T ​ [ ‖ ∇ 𝐱 T A 𝜽 ​ ( 𝐱 T , c ) ‖ 2 2 ] \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{x}_{T}}[\|\nabla_{\mathbf{x}_{T}}A_{\bm{\theta}}(\mathbf{x}_{T},c)\|_{2}^{2}] . As the model successfully unlearns the target concept, the activation landscape A 𝜽 A_{\bm{\theta}} flattens and globally approaches zero. blocks.en: The per-style results show that the average gains in the main paper are consistent across targets rather than being driven by a small subset of styles. ACE and RECELER already achieve 100% UA for every target, leaving no room for further improvement in removal accuracy; nevertheless, Adaptive Noise Sampling improves retention for every style, increasing mean IRA/CRA by 1.20/2.87 points for ACE and by 2.36/2.06 points for RECELER. EAP exhibits the largest removal gain: UA increases by approximately 4.1 points for every target and reaches 100% on six of the ten styles, while mean IRA and CRA also increase by 2.12 and 2.81 points, respectively. ESD likewise improves all three metrics for every target, with mean gains of 0.60 points in UA, 2.51 points in IRA, and 2.75 points in CRA. Some method-specific weaknesses remain—for example, Crayon has the lowest UA for ESD (85.00%), Monet has its lowest IRA (69.06%), and Picasso and Van Gogh remain the lowest-CRA targets for EAP (82.23%) and RECELER (83.60%), respectively. Overall, the absence of a per-style trade-off—UA never decreases, while IRA and CRA increase in every comparison—indicates that the adaptive strategy strengthens concept removal or preserves an already saturated removal rate while consistently reducing collateral degradation of non-target styles and content.
blocks.zh: 每个风格的结果表明,主要论文中的平均收益在各目标之间是一致的,而不是由一小段风格驱动. ACE和RECELER已经实现每个目标的100%普遍获得,没有进一步改进去除精度的空间;然而,适应性噪声抽样改进了每种样式的保留,使ACE的IRA/CRA平均值增加了1.20/2.87分,RECELER增加了2.336/2.06分。 EAP表现出最大的去除增益:每个目标普遍获得增加约4.1分,在十种样式中的六种上达到100%,而平均IRA和CRA也分别增加2.12分和2.81分. 教育促进可持续性发展同样改进了每个目标的所有三个衡量标准,普遍获得的平均值为0.60分,爱尔兰共和军的平均值为2.51分,CRA的平均值为2.75分。 一些方法特有的弱点依然存在——例如,Crayon对ESD的普遍获得率最低(85.00%),Monet对IRA最低(69.06%),毕加索和Van Gogh仍然是EAP(82.23%)和RECELER(83.60%)的最低CRA目标。 总的来说,没有一种按类型进行权衡的取舍——普遍获得的取舍——从未减少,而爱尔兰共和军和爱尔兰共和军在每次比较中都有所增加,这表明适应性战略加强了概念的去除或维持了已经饱和的去除率,同时始终减少非目标样式和内容的附带退化。

blocks.en: Appendix G Object Unlearning
blocks.zh: 附录G

blocks.en: To evaluate whether our noise-aware unlearning framework generalizes beyond abstract concepts, we apply it to object unlearning. Following prior work ( Biswas et al., 2025 ) , we conduct experiments on ten object categories from the Imagenette benchmark Howard and Gugger (2020) . Each target object (e.g., French Horn ) is treated as the forget concept. We use a frozen InceptionV3 classifier ( Szegedy et al., 2015 ) as the guidance classifier f f during training and the architecturally distinct ResNet-50 ( He et al., 2016 ) for evaluation. This separation prevents circular evaluation and classifier-specific reward hacking. To ensure statistical robustness, for the erased class we generate 500 images using distinct random seeds and report the ResNet-50 Top-1 accuracy (lower is better). For preservation, we generate 500 images for each of the nine remaining object classes (4,500 images total) and report the averaged Top-1 accuracy (higher is better).
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的无噪声知识框架是否超越抽象概念,我们把它应用于非学习对象。 继先前的工作(Biswas等人,2025年)之后,我们从Imagenette基准Howard和Gugger(2020年)进行十类物体的实验. 每个目标对象(如法兰西角)都被视为遗忘的概念. 我们使用一个冷冻的InceptionV3分类器(Szegedy等人,2015年)作为培训过程中的指导分类器ff和建筑上独特的ResNet-50(He等人,2016年)用于评价. 这种分离防止了循环评价和分类器特定奖励黑客化. 为确保统计稳健性,对于被抹去的类,我们利用明显的随机种子生成500张图像,并报告ResNet-50 Top-1的准确性(更低). 为了保存起见,我们为剩下的9个物体类别(总共4500个图像)中的每一类生成500个图像,并报告平均Top-1的准确性(更高的更好).

blocks.en: Table 5: Class-wise ResNet-50 evaluation results on Imagenette using InceptionV3 for adaptive guidance. For each target class, we report Erased Accuracy (lower is better) and Other Class Accuracy (higher is better).
blocks.zh: 表5:利用InceptionV3进行适应性指导的Imagenette的经典ResNet-50评价结果。 对于每个目标类别,我们报告Erased精确度(下级更好)和其他类别精确度(上级更好).

blocks.en: Table 5 reports class-wise results. While baselines like EAP and RECELER achieve near-zero erasure error on standard evaluations, they often suffer from degradation in general model utility (e.g., RECELER drops to 72.5% on non-target classes). Applying our Adaptive Noise Sampling significantly mitigates this trade-off. For example, with RECELER , our method boosts non-target preservation by +7.4 points (72.5% → \to 79.9%) while maintaining robust erasure ( < 1 % <1\% error). Similarly, for EAP and ESD, while our method introduces a negligible relaxation in absolute erasure (e.g., EAP error shifts from 0.0 to 1.1), this trade-off is outweighed by the substantial + 1.2 +1.2 point recovery in global class preservation, demonstrating that we prevent the destructive “over-unlearning” of the baselines.
blocks.zh: 表5按类别报告结果。 虽然像EAP和RECELER这样的基线在标准评价上实现了近乎零的消除错误,但它们在一般模型用途中往往会出现退化(例如,RECELER在非目标类别中下降到72.5%). 运用我们的适应性噪音抽样可以大大缓解这种权衡。 例如,通过RECELER,我们的方法将非目标保存提升到+7.4分(72.5%~\to 79.9%),同时保持坚固的消除( < 1% < 1+% 错误)。 同样,对于EAP和ESD来说,虽然我们的方法引入了绝对消除的微弱放松(例如EAP错误从0.0转至1.1),但全球分类保全中的重大+1.2+1.2点恢复超过了这种权衡,这表明我们防止了基线的破坏性“过度学习”。

To test whether the framework’s efficacy depends on the guidance architecture, we repeat the Imagenette experiments after replacing InceptionV3 with EfficientNet Tan and Le (2019) and MobileNetV2 Sandler et al. With MobileNetV2 guidance, target-class error increases for all four methods. Non-target retention improves substantially for RECELER but decreases slightly for ESD, ACE, and EAP. These results show that alternative guidance classifiers can be incorporated without changing the framework.

blocks.en: Appendix I Classifier Ablations for Nudity Unlearning
blocks.zh: 附录一 营养学分类法

blocks.en: I.1 CLIP Classifier Ablation
blocks.zh: I.1 CLIP 分类符

blocks.en: The main nudity experiments use NudeNet NudeNet Developers (2023) for adaptive guidance and Open-NSFW2 Yung (2023) for evaluation. To test whether the improvements depend on the guidance detector, Table 8 replaces NudeNet guidance with a zero-shot CLIP classifier while retaining Open-NSFW2 for evaluation. Thus, this ablation changes only the training-time classifier.
blocks.zh: 主要裸体实验使用NudeNet NudeNet开发者(2023年)进行适应性指导,Open-NSFW2 Yung(2023年)进行评价. 为了测试改进是否依赖于制导检测器,表8将NudeNet制导替换为零镜头的CLIP分类器,同时保留Open-NSFW2用于评价. 因此,这种缩减只改变了培训时间的分类。

blocks.en: As detailed in Table 8 , replacing the main NudeNet guidance with CLIP retains the improvement over standard uniform-sampling baselines across all four methods. For instance, EAP with CLIP guidance yields 644 failures, close to the 638 failures obtained with the primary NudeNet guidance, while maintaining comparable general image quality. Thus, the benefit of adaptive noise sampling is not specific to NudeNet.
blocks.zh: 如表8所详述,用CLIP取代主要NudeNet指导保留了对所有四种方法的标准统一抽样基线的改进。 例如,使用CLIP制导的EAP产生644个故障,接近使用初级NudeNet制导获得的638个故障,同时保持可比较的一般图像质量。 因此,适应性噪声取样的好处并非是NudeNet特有的。

blocks.en: Table 8: Ablation of CLIP as the training-time classifier for nudity unlearning. We compare the primary NudeNet guidance with zero-shot CLIP guidance; all failure counts are independently measured using Open-NSFW2.
blocks.zh: 表8:将CLIP作为裸体不学习的培训时间分类器。 我们比较初级NudeNet指导与零镜头的CLIP指导;所有故障计数均使用Open-NSFW2独立测量.

blocks.en: These results demonstrate that the framework is not dependent on the mechanics of a particular guidance classifier. The main experiments use NudeNet for nudity guidance, InceptionV3 for object guidance, and CLIP for style guidance, while independent classifiers are used for nudity and object evaluation. This ablation confirms that CLIP can replace NudeNet in the nudity setting without changing the adaptive sampling formulation.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,框架并不取决于特定指导分类器的力学。 主要实验使用NudeNet进行裸体指导,InceptionV3进行对象指导,CLIP进行样式指导,而独立分类器则用于裸体和对象评价. 这种萎缩证实,CLIP可以在裸体设置中取代NudeNet,而不改变适应性的采样配方.

blocks.en: I.2 Classifier Robustness to Image Distortions
blocks.zh: I.2 图像扭曲的强度

blocks.en: We next stress-test the NudeNet guidance signal under controlled image corruption. First, we isolate the classifier itself to establish a baseline of its inherent stability. We evaluate NudeNet’s robustness by applying varying levels of Gaussian noise ( σ \sigma ) to the generated images prior to classification. As shown in Table 9 , the classifier remains highly resilient to moderate distortions, maintaining a strong 0.68 0.68 confidence at σ = 0.05 \sigma=0.05 (compared to the 0.77 0.77 clean baseline). A severe drop in detection performance only occurs once the input is heavily corrupted ( σ ≥ 0.10 \sigma\geq 0.10 ), where confidence falls to 0.51 0.51 and below.
blocks.zh: 接下来在受控图像腐败下测试NudeNet的引导信号 首先,我们孤立分类者本身,以确定其内在稳定的基线。 我们评价NudeNet的稳健性, 如表9所示,分类器在中度扭曲时仍然具有高度的弹性,保持了0.68 0.68的强烈置信度,为= 0.05\sigma=0.05(而清洁基线为0.77 0.77)。 只有在输入严重损坏时,检测性能才会出现严重下降(σ0.10\sigma\geq 0.10),信任度降至0.510.51和以下.

blocks.en: Table 9: Classifier confidence scores under increasing Gaussian noise levels ( σ \sigma ). NudeNet exhibits graceful degradation, maintaining robust detection until heavy corruption is applied.
blocks.zh: 表9:高斯噪声水平提高下的分类器置信度分数 (\\sigma ). NudeNet显示出优雅的退化,在严重腐败发生之前保持有力的侦查。

blocks.en: I.3 End-to-End Robustness to Corrupted Guidance
blocks.zh: 一.3 端到端强腐蚀性指导

blocks.en: To understand how this detection instability affects the overall unlearning process, we test Adaptive Noise Sampling with NudeNet as the training-time classifier while applying Gaussian noise ( σ \sigma ) to the generated images during unlearning. This intentionally corrupts the NudeNet guidance signal, simulating a setting in which the classifier is unreliable. Open-NSFW2 remains the independent evaluation classifier throughout this stress test.
blocks.zh: 为了了解这种探测不稳定性如何影响整个不学习过程,我们用NudeNet测试适应性噪声抽样,作为训练时间分类器,同时在不学习时将高斯噪声应用到生成的图像上。 这故意腐蚀NudeNet引导信号,模拟一个分类器不可靠的设置. Open-NSFW2在整个压力测试中仍然是独立的评价分类器.

blocks.en: As detailed in Table 10 , even when the guidance signal is intentionally corrupted, our adaptive method consistently outperforms the standard uniform-sampling baselines. For example, when applying our adaptive framework to ESD, it exhibits remarkable robustness; even at the extreme noise level of σ = 0.15 \sigma=0.15 , it restricts failures to 308, easily surpassing the uncorrupted standard ESD baseline (510 failures). Likewise, even at σ = 0.10 \sigma=0.10 where the classifier’s confidence is severely degraded, our approach applied to ACE yields a failure count of 148, which remains vastly superior to the standard ACE baseline (491 failures). Similar resilience is observed across the other frameworks. When integrating our method with EAP under σ = 0.10 \sigma=0.10 noise, it limits failures to 734, a substantial improvement over the standard EAP baseline’s 1142 failures. Furthermore, when applied to RECELER at the highest evaluated noise level ( σ = 0.15 \sigma=0.15 ), our framework incurs only 433 failures—still significantly outperforming the uncorrupted standard RECELER baseline (693 failures) while simultaneously improving the CLIP score ( 0.237 → 0.244 0.237\to 0.244 ). This demonstrates that our framework degrades gracefully across diverse unlearning architectures; it relies on the directional accuracy of the classifier rather than perfect point-wise precision, maintaining strong unlearning efficacy and general image quality (CLIP) even under suboptimal guidance conditions.
blocks.zh: 如表10所详述的,即使故意破坏指导信号,我们的适应方法也始终超过标准的统一抽样基准。 例如,在将我们的适应框架应用于教育促进可持续性发展时,它表现出了显著的强性;即使在极端噪声水平为 = 0.15\sigma= 0.15时,它将故障限制在 308 ,容易超过未腐蚀的标准教育促进可持续性发展基线(510 个故障)。 同样,即便在分类者信心严重下降的= 0.10\sigma= 0.10 时,我们适用于ACE的方法也得出148的失败数,这仍然大大高于ACE标准基线(491失败)。 其他框架也有类似的复原力。 当我们的方法与EAP在 = = 0.10\sigma= 0. 10 噪声下结合时, 将失败限制在 734 , 这比标准 EAP 基线的 1142 失败有实质性改善 。 此外,在对RECELER适用最高评价噪声等级(= 0.15\sigma=0.15)时,我们的框架只发生433次故障——仍然大大超过未损坏的标准RECELER基线(693次故障),同时提高了CLIP的得分(0.237~0.244 0.237\=0.244)。 这表明,我们的框架在不同的非学习结构中优异地退化;它依赖于分类器的方向准确性,而不是完美的点精度,即使在不理想的指导条件下,也保持强大的非学习效果和一般图像质量。

Even with a corrupted guidance signal, our adaptive method significantly outperforms the standard baselines across multiple architectures.

blocks.en: Appendix J Computational Overhead and Optimization Efficiency
blocks.zh: 附录J 计算 间接费用和优化效率

blocks.en: Adaptive Noise Sampling introduces a forward-pass scan over N N candidate noise vectors but substantially reduces the number of gradient-update steps needed to reach the reported checkpoints. Under standard uniform sampling, both ACE and EAP use 2,000 optimization steps. With our method, ACE uses 500 steps and EAP uses 300 steps, corresponding to reductions of 75% and 85%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 适应性噪声抽样对N候选噪声矢量进行前传扫描,但大大减少了进入所报告的检查站所需的梯度更新步骤。 在标准的统一采样下,ACE和EAP都使用2000个优化步骤. 用我们的方法,ACE使用500步,而EAP使用300步,分别相当于75%和85%的削减.

blocks.en: To characterize the computational trade-off, Table 11 reports the per-step cost of scanning N N candidates, while Table 12 reports the total end-to-end runtime. Although our method requires fewer gradient-update steps, the candidate scan increases wall-clock runtime under the current implementation. Because unlearning is a one-time model edit, this modest overhead—hours rather than days—is a practical cost for improved unlearning accuracy, retention, and adversarial robustness. We therefore interpret these results as improved optimization-step efficiency rather than wall-clock acceleration.
blocks.zh: 为了说明计算权衡的特点,表11报告了扫描N N候选人的每步费用,表12报告了从端到端的总运行时间。 虽然我们的方法要求更少的梯度更新步骤,但候选人扫描会增加当前执行下的墙上小时运行时间. 由于不学习是一种一次性的模式编辑,这种有限的间接费用——小时而不是天数——是提高不学习准确性、保留率和对抗性的实际代价。 因此,我们将这些成果解释为优化步骤效率的提高,而不是时钟加速。

blocks.en: Table 11: Average time cost (in seconds) per step for the forward-pass exploration scan across N N candidates. Because this step relies solely on the frozen guidance classifier and the base diffusion model, this overhead is uniform across all underlying unlearning methods.
blocks.zh: 表11:NN候选人前传勘探扫描每步平均时间成本(秒). 由于这一步骤完全依赖于冷冻的制导分类器和基底扩散模型,因此这一管理费在所有基础的不学习方法上是统一的.

blocks.en: Table 12: Total wall-clock training time for the standard baselines and Adaptive Noise Sampling configured with N = 20 N=20 and M = 4 M=4 . The adaptive variants use fewer gradient-update steps but incur additional runtime from candidate scanning.

blocks.en: J.1 Hardware and Peak Memory Requirements
blocks.zh: J.1 硬件和峰值内存要求

blocks.en: All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU with 40 GB of VRAM. Under our standard configuration ( N = 20 N=20 , M = 4 M=4 ), the exploration of the N N candidate noise vectors is implemented as a strictly detached forward-pass scan. Consequently, no computation graph for the full diffusion trajectories is retained, and backpropagation is performed only through the selected Top- M M samples. The backward-pass memory requirement is therefore bounded by the selected update batch size M M , rather than by the exploration pool size N N .
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在单NVIDIA A100 GPU上进行的,其中含有40GB的VRAM. 在我们的标准配置(N = 20 N = 20,M = 4 M = 4)下,对N N 候选噪声矢量的探索作为严格脱落的前传扫描执行. 因此,没有保留关于全部扩散轨迹的计算图,只通过选定的Top-M M样品进行反扩散。 因此,后行存储要求以选定的更新批量尺寸MM为界,而不是以勘探池大小NN为界。

blocks.en: This separation between the sampling strategy and the underlying unlearning optimization prevents peak VRAM usage from increasing drastically. In practice, the peak memory footprint of our method remains comparable to that of the corresponding standard uniform-sampling baseline. Table 13 reports the observed peak VRAM utilization when applying our standard configuration to each baseline method.
blocks.zh: 这种将取样战略与基础的不学习优化分开的做法,防止了VRAM的峰值使用急剧增加。 在实践中,我们方法的峰值记忆足迹仍然与相应的标准统一取样基线相当。 表13汇报了在将我们的标准配置应用于每一基线方法时观察到的VRAM峰值利用率。

blocks.en: Table 13: Peak VRAM utilization on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU using Adaptive Noise Sampling with N = 20 N=20 and M = 4 M=4 . Because candidate exploration is detached from the unlearning backward pass, memory usage remains comparable to standard uniform-sampling optimization.
blocks.zh: 表13:峰值VRAM 使用适应性噪声取样法,在单一的NVIDIA A100 GPU上使用N=20N=20和M=4M=4。 由于候选探索脱离了不学习的后传传球,内存使用率仍与标准的统一抽样优化相当.

blocks.en: Appendix K Ablation Study: Hyperparameter Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 附录K 研究:超参数 敏感性

blocks.en: To systematically evaluate the sensitivity of our Adaptive Noise Sampling framework, we conducted a comprehensive ablation study varying our core hyperparameters: the candidate pool size ( N N ), the update batch size ( M M ), and the regularization constant ( γ \gamma ). Table 14 reports the Failure Count (multi-seed evaluation) across various configurations of ( N , M N,M ) for four baselines: ACE, ESD, EAP, and RECELER.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地评估我们适应性噪声抽样框架的敏感性,我们进行了一项综合研究,其中改变了我们的核心超参数:候选池大小(N N)、更新批量大小(M M)和规范化常数(γ\gamma)。 表14按四个基线(ACE、ESD、EAP和RECELER)报告不同组合(N、M N、M)的失败计数(多种子评价)。

blocks.en: Table 14: Ablation study on the candidate pool ( N N ) and update batch ( M M ) sizes using NudeNet for guidance and Open-NSFW2 for evaluation. We report the multi-seed Failure Count (lower is better) across four baselines. The standard baselines (top row) represent uniform sampling without our adaptive framework.
blocks.zh: 表14:关于候选人才库(N N )和更新批量(M M)规模的研究,使用NudeNet进行指导,Open-NSFW2进行评价. 我们报告四个基线的多种子失败计数(较低更好)。 标准基线(上行)代表没有我们适应性框架的统一取样。

blocks.en: The results in Table 14 highlight the distinct roles of exploration and exploitation in our framework. Increasing the exploration pool ( N N ) allows the framework to discover more elusive, high-activation noise trajectories. Concurrently, increasing the update batch ( M M ) provides a stronger, more stable gradient signal for unlearning. While maximizing both parameters naturally yields the lowest failure rates (e.g., N = 40 , M = 8 N=40,M=8 achieves 52 failures on ACE), we observe heavily diminishing returns as computational costs scale. We empirically selected N = 20 N=20 and M = 4 M=4 for our primary experiments as it strikes the optimal trade-off: it achieves near-optimal robustness (60 failures on ACE) while strictly bounding the memory overhead of the backward pass to match a standard batch size of 4.
blocks.zh: 表14中的结果突出了勘探和开发在我们框架内的独特作用。 增加勘探池(N N)可以使框架发现更难捉摸的高活性噪声轨迹. 同时,增加更新批量(MM)为未学习提供了更强大,更稳定的梯度信号. 虽然将这两个参数最大化自然产生最低的失败率(例如N=40,M=8N=40,M=8在ACE上实现52个失败),但我们观察到作为计算成本尺度,回报率大幅下降. 我们经验性地选择了N = 20 N = 20和M = 4 M = 4作为我们的首要实验,因为它打击了最佳的取舍:它实现了近乎最佳的坚固性(ACE上的60个故障),同时严格限定了落后通行证的内存高度,以匹配标准批量大小为4.

blocks.en: Importantly, this scaling behavior is highly consistent across all evaluated architectures. Under our selected N = 20 , M = 4 N=20,M=4 configuration, EAP failures are nearly halved from 1142 to 638, and RECELER failures drop dramatically from 693 to 326. Furthermore, the data reveals that even the most computationally lightweight configuration ( N = 4 , M = 1 N=4,M=1 ) vastly outperforms the standard uniform-sampling baselines across the board. For instance, simply updating on the single worst-case noise out of a small pool of 4 candidates reduces ACE failures from 491 to 119. This demonstrates that the core theoretical mechanism of our framework—purposefully guiding the optimization toward high-risk noise regions—is fundamentally effective even without aggressive hyperparameter scaling.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,这种规模化行为在所有被评价的架构中高度一致. 根据我们选定的N = 20,M = 4 N = 20,M = 4配置,EAP故障从1142降至638,RECELER故障从693大幅降至326. 此外,数据显示,即使计算最轻的重量配置(N=4,M=1N=4,M=1)也大大超过标准的统一抽样基线。 例如,仅仅从4名候选人中更新一个最坏的噪音,就把ACE的故障从491次减少到119次。 这表明,我们框架的核心理论机制——有目的地指导向高风险噪声区域优化——即使没有积极的超参数放大,也从根本上有效。

blocks.en: We additionally evaluated the sensitivity of the framework to the regularization constant γ \gamma . Performance remained consistent across the tested range from 10 − 5 10^{-5} to 10 − 3 10^{-3} . We therefore use γ = 10 − 4 \gamma=10^{-4} for all reported experiments.

blocks.en: Appendix L Scaling to Larger Architectures: Stable Diffusion 2.1
blocks.zh: 附录L 放大到更大的建筑:稳定扩散 2.1

blocks.en: To verify that our Adaptive Noise Sampling framework scales effectively to larger, more complex generative models, we extend our nudity unlearning experiments to Stable Diffusion 2.1 (SD 2.1). For this evaluation, we integrate our framework with EAP and ESD, both of which provide stable, established support for the SD 2.1 architecture, using NudeNet for adaptive guidance and Open-NSFW2 for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了核实我们的适应性噪声抽样框架是否有效达到更大、更复杂的基因模型,我们将裸体不学习实验扩大到稳定扩散2.1(SD 2.1)。 为了这一评价,我们把我们的框架与EAP和ESD相结合,两者都为SD 2.1架构提供了稳定的既定支持,使用NudeNet进行适应性指导,Open-NSFW2进行评价。

blocks.en: As detailed in Table 15 , our adaptive framework seamlessly generalizes to this higher-capacity model, delivering substantial improvements over the standard uniform-sampling baselines. When applied to EAP, our method reduces the rigorous 20-seed failure count from 1413 to 985. The gains are even more pronounced when integrated with ESD, where our approach aggressively cuts the 20-seed failure count from 673 down to just 250—a reduction of over 60%.
blocks.zh: 如表15所详述的,我们的适应性框架无缝地概括了这种高能力模式,比标准的统一抽样基线大有改进。 在应用到EAP时,我们的方法将严格的20种子衰竭计数从1413年减少到985年. 在与教育促进可持续性发展相结合时,收益更为明显,我们的方法将20种种子的失败数从673降至250,即减少60%以上。

blocks.en: Crucially, these dramatic improvements in unlearning efficacy do not come at the cost of visual fidelity. In fact, our framework slightly improves the CLIP scores for both EAP ( 0.233 → 0.236 0.233\to 0.236 ) and ESD ( 0.221 → 0.223 0.221\to 0.223 ). This confirms that dynamically targeting the most relevant regions of the noise manifold successfully protects global generative quality, even as the underlying model capacity and parameter dimensionality increase.
blocks.zh: 关键是,这些在未学习效果方面的显著改进并不以视觉忠诚为代价。 事实上,我们的框架对EAP(0.233 → 0.236 0.233\to 0.236)和ESD(0.221 → 0.223 0.221\to 0.223)的CLIP分数略有改善。 这证实,即使在基本模型能力和参数维度增加的情况下,动态地针对噪声多倍体中最相关的区域,成功地保护了全球基因质量。

blocks.en: Appendix M Proof of Concept on a DiT Architecture: Stable Diffusion 3
blocks.zh: 附录 M  DiT 架构概念证明:稳定扩散 3

blocks.en: To evaluate whether Adaptive Noise Sampling generalizes beyond U-Net-based diffusion models, we conduct a proof-of-concept experiment on Stable Diffusion 3 (SD3), which uses a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture. We use Direct Unlearning Optimization (DUO) Park et al. (2024) , a DiT-compatible unlearning method, as the baseline and apply our sampling strategy without modifying the underlying DUO objective. We use NudeNet for adaptive guidance and Open-NSFW2 for evaluation under both the standard single-seed protocol and the more rigorous 20-seed protocol.
blocks.zh: 为了评估适应性噪声取样是否超越了基于U-Net的传播模型,我们在稳定传播3(SD3)上进行了概念证明实验,该实验使用了扩散变压器(DIT)架构. 我们使用直接学习优化(DUO) Park等人(2024年),一种与DiT兼容的不学习方法,作为基线,并运用我们的取样战略,而不修改基本的DUO目标。 我们利用NudeNet提供适应性指导,利用Open-NSFW2进行标准单种协议和更严格的20种协议的评估。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 16 , Adaptive Noise Sampling improves the robustness of DUO on SD3. It reduces the single-seed failure count from 60 to 46, a 23.3 % 23.3\% reduction, and the 20-seed failure count from 1245 to 938, a 24.7 % 24.7\% reduction. At the same time, the CLIP score increases slightly from 0.2385 0.2385 to 0.2399 0.2399 , indicating that the improved erasure does not compromise text–image alignment. These results provide initial evidence that our framework transfers to DiT architectures without architecture-specific modifications and reduces the probabilistic tail risk associated with unfavorable noise initializations.
blocks.zh: 如表16所示,适应性噪声取样提高了SD3上的DUO的强度. 将单种失败计数从60减为46,23.3%减为23.3\%,20种失败计数从1245减为938,24.7%减为24.7\%. 同时,CLIP的得分也从0.2385 0.2385略增至0.23990.2399,表明改进后的去除不会影响文本-图像对齐. 这些结果提供了初步证据,证明我们的框架向DiT架构的转移没有针对架构的特定修改,并减少了与不合适的噪声初始化相关的概率尾巴风险.

blocks.en: Appendix O Adversarial Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录O 横向评价

blocks.en: We further evaluate whether the robustness gains from Adaptive Noise Sampling persist under adversarial attacks designed to recover erased concepts. For each underlying unlearning method, we attack both its standard checkpoint ( Base ) and the corresponding checkpoint trained with our adaptive sampling strategy ( Ours ). This paired comparison isolates the contribution of Adaptive Noise Sampling while holding the underlying unlearning objective fixed. We consider the black-box Ring-A-Bell attack Tsai et al. (2024) and the white-box UnlearnDiffAtk (UDA) attack Zhang et al. (2024c) . We report attack success rate (ASR), which provides a normalized and directly comparable measure of adversarial robustness across attacks and evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估在旨在恢复被抹去的概念的对抗性攻击下,适应性噪声抽样的强性是否继续存在。 我们攻击其标准检查站(基地)和相应的检查站, 这种对齐的比较隔离了适应性噪声抽样的作用,同时将基础的不学习目标固定下来. 我们认为黑盒环A-贝尔攻击蔡等人(2024年)和白盒UnlearnDiffAtk(UDA)攻击张等人(2024年c). 我们报告攻击成功率(ASR),它为攻击和评价环境的对抗性强度提供了一个正常和直接可比的衡量标准。

blocks.en: To further validate our findings beyond automatic classifiers, we conduct a human evaluation on nudity unlearning. We randomly select 100 prompts from the nudity subset and generate images using 20 random seeds per prompt, resulting in 2000 images per method. Five annotators (a mix of undergraduate and graduate students) were recruited for the study. Prior to annotation, participants were explicitly informed that the images may contain nudity and provided consent to proceed.
blocks.zh: 为了在自动分类器之外进一步验证我们的调查结果,我们对裸体不学习进行人类评价。 我们随机从裸体子集中选择100个提示,并使用每个提示的20个随机种子生成图像,得出每个方法的2000个图像. 为该研究征聘了5名注释员(本科生和研究生混合)。 在作出说明之前,与会者被明确告知,图像可能含有裸体,并表示同意继续进行。

blocks.en: Each image was independently annotated with a binary label indicating whether nudity is present. Table 20 reports the total number of images labeled as nude (failure count) and the corresponding failure ratio. Consistent with the automatic evaluation, our method substantially reduces the presence of nudity compared to all baselines. In particular, when applied on top of ACE and ESD, our approach achieves the lowest failure rates, indicating more reliable suppression of the target concept across diverse noise initializations. These results confirm that the improvements observed with automated detectors translate to human perception, strengthening the practical relevance of our unlearning framework.
blocks.zh: 每个图像都用二进制标签独立注释,说明裸体是否存在. 表20报告标为裸体的图像总数(失败计数)和相应的故障率。 与自动评估一致,我们的方法比所有基线大大降低了裸体的存在。 特别是在ACE和ESD之上应用时,我们的方法实现了最低的故障率,表明在各种噪声初始化中更可靠地抑制目标概念. 这些结果证实,通过自动探测器观察到的改进转化为人类的认知,加强了我们不学习框架的实际相关性。

blocks.en: We provide additional qualitative results to complement the quantitative evaluations in the main paper, highlighting the behavior of our noise-aware unlearning strategy under controlled and stochastic settings. In particular, we examine both (i) fixed prompt–seed conditions and (ii) variations across different unlearning methods and noise initializations.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了更多的定性结果,以补充主要文件中的定量评价,强调我们在受控制和有条不紊的环境下的噪音意识无学战略的行为。 特别是,我们审查(一) 固定的即时种子条件和(二) 不同不学习方法和噪声初始化的差异。

blocks.en: Figure 7 presents results generated using the same prompt and the same random seed across methods. Under identical noise initialization, our approach produces images that remain visually consistent with the baseline generation—preserving scene layout, structure, and semantic content—while successfully removing the forbidden concept. This demonstrates that our method performs targeted unlearning without introducing unnecessary deviations or artifacts when the stochastic factors are held constant.
blocks.zh: 图7显示了使用同样迅速和相同的随机种子不同方法产生的结果。 在相同的噪声初始化下,我们的方法产生与基线生成保持视觉一致的图像——保留场景布局、结构和语义内容——同时成功地去除被禁止的概念。 这表明,当结构因素保持不变时,我们的方法具有针对性地不学习,而不引入不必要的偏差或文物。

blocks.en: Figure 8 compares different unlearning methods under the same prompt . While baseline approaches often exhibit residual appearances of the target concept or noticeable degradation in image quality, our method more reliably suppresses the concept across stochastic samples, maintaining visual plausibility and prompt faithfulness. Together, these examples illustrate that explicitly accounting for noise-space structure leads to more robust and stable unlearning behavior under both deterministic and stochastic generation settings.
blocks.zh: 图8 在同一快件下比较不同的未学习方法。 虽然基线方法往往显示出目标概念的残余外观或图像质量的明显退化,但我们的方法更可靠地压制了整个图样的概念,保持视觉上的合理性和迅速的忠诚。 这些例子共同说明,明确说明噪音-空间结构会导致在决定性和有条理的生成环境下采取更有力和更稳定的不学习行为。
